diagram_previews.alt: Graph of y = (x - 1)(x + 2)(x - 3)/((x + 1)(x - 2)) with dashed vertical asymptotes x = -1 and x = 2 and the dashed oblique asymptote y = x - 1; the three branches cross the x-axis at -2, 1 and 3, and the middle branch crosses the y-axis at -3.

difficulty_rationale: Needs a sign analysis around three zeros and two vertical asymptotes, and polynomial division for the oblique asymptote.
